mapper.insert: INSERT INTO volunteer (user_id, real_name, id_card, phone, org_name, cert_type, cert_file, intro, audit_status, apply_time) VALUES (#{userId}, #{realName}, #{idCard}, #{phone}, #{orgName}, #{certType}, #{certFile}, #{intro}, 1, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM volunteer WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY volunteer_id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT v.*, u.username, u.nickname FROM volunteer v LEFT JOIN user u ON v.user_id = u.user_id
AND v.audit_status = #{status}
AND (v.real_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR u.username LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
ORDER BY v.apply_time DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE volunteer SET audit_status = #{auditStatus}, audit_opinion = #{auditOpinion}, audit_admin_id = #{auditAdminId}, audit_time = NOW() WHERE volunteer_id = #{volunteerId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM volunteer WHERE audit_status = #{status}
